contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [SALVS AVG] or [COS IIII], S C ; D/ M ANTONINVS AVG PIVS [...]

A copper-alloy sestertius of Antoninus Pius, (AD 138-161), dating to AD 140-161(Reece period 7). Reverse legend reads [SALVS AVG] or [COS IIII], S C. Reverse shows Salus standing left at altar. Mint is Rome. Cf. RIC III, p. 111, no. 635 or p. 124, no. 762. Obverse legend reads M ANTONINVS AVG PIVS [...]. Obverse shows laureate head right. Die axis is 12 o'clock.
